scope: Metric-only existing Iceberg live attempted-read counter injection and normal DataFusion source metrics. No projection or source pruning behavior change.

gates.linux_only_spill: Not compiled/run on macOS; no Linux claim.

semantics: Full native keyed output oracle97 integers unchanged.
Public PreparedTable.start_action replays/concurrent actions create4independent native metric domains while the plan registry cumulatively retains them.
Repeated MetricsSet.sum(predicate) summaries leave the live source counters unchanged. sum_by_name is not used for Custom metrics.
Dropping after a first batch retains a monotone instantaneous observation. Fixture may already have read all data; no in-flight cancellation/quiescence claim.
Removing a real data file after public preparation produces the normal execution error and0attempted read_at bytes; no private format corruption fixture.
Explicit caller-owned shared live counter is positive across a real multi-file scan while an unrelated counter stays0. This does not assert independently measured per-file additive totals.
ownership: Fresh ScanMetrics in each native SourceExec/ReadKeyFilteredExec/ComputedExec/IntervalSourceExec execute call; never placed in shared SnapshotReadPlan or VortexSessionCache.
Existing CountingFileRead increments range length before awaiting the backing read. The supplied live domain replaces the default fresh counter, adding no second per-read atomic increment.
CustomMetricValue holds that live source. new_empty returns a source-free accumulator; aggregation reads values without mutating the source counter.
Registry size and summary work are cumulative O(execute calls × source partitions), bounded by plan lifetime rather than a fixed-size latest-execution slot.
limits: Observed attempted request bytes, including data/footer/delete file reader requests, not successful completion or physical disk traffic/decompression/bandwidth.
Snapshot/catalog metadata read before execution is not counted.
After normal collection values are observations at collection time, not proof that no background work can issue later requests. Cancellation observations are instantaneous lower bounds.
No speedup, IO savings, source pruning or bounded-registry-growth claim.

Repeated control attempted to replay one consumer plan directly and hit the preexisting consumer-once guard. Fixed test-only to use public PreparedTable.start_action; did not relax/bypass guard.
